# Gold Scalpers

> Gold Scalpers (goldscalpers.com) makes Gold Scalpers Pro, an Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that trades gold (XAUUSD) on the M5 timeframe. It costs $140 once, with updates and a 30-day refund. It always trades with a stop loss and does not use grid or martingale. Published performance figures are backtests; there is no public live account yet.

Last updated: 2026-11-14. The product is also referred to as "Gold Scalpers EA". It is not related to "GOLD Scalper PRO EA" (goldscalperpro.com), which is a different product from a different seller.

## Product facts: Gold Scalpers Pro
- Type: automated trading robot (Expert Advisor) for MetaTrader 5. Gold (XAUUSD) only, M5 chart. Version 4.50 (October 2026) on the website.
- Price: $140 one-time, lifetime licence, all updates, 30-day money-back guarantee. No subscription.
- Where it is sold: goldscalpers.com/checkout (card and wallet payments through Gumroad, or crypto) and the MQL5 Market (product 191087). A free edition, "Gold Scalpers EA", is on the MQL5 Market (product 184515).
- Entries: two triggers, both on by default. (1) The Slope Direction Line crosses the 50 EMA. (2) The Slope line changes direction on the correct side of the 50 EMA. Every signal must also pass a ZeroLag MACD filter, a chop filter, a confirmation candle, a spread cap and a news pause. Only closed candles count.
- Exits: a stop loss on every trade, set when the order is sent. Break-even lock at +300 pips. Targets of 1,200 pips (cross entries) and 300 pips (turn entries).
- Position sizing: a fixed lot (FixedLot). The backtests use 0.01 lot per $1,000.
- Risk controls: 16% drawdown stop with a 10% warning, daily trade cap, loss-streak cooldown, spread cap, session filter, news filter (pauses new entries 30 minutes either side of high-impact USD releases), and Prop-Firm Mode (percentage daily-loss and max-drawdown limits with a hard stop).
- Not grid, not martingale, no averaging into losing trades. Adding to winners (UseScaleIn) exists and is off by default.
- Licence: bound to the buyer's MT5 account number; https://goldscalpers.com must be on MT5's WebRequest list.
- Optional AI news trading on the website edition (HotStoryTrade). It cannot be backtested and is not in any published figure.

## Performance, as published by the developer
All figures are MetaTrader 5 Strategy Tester backtests on real XAUUSD ticks, 0.01 lot on a $1,000 deposit. They are not live results.
- 14 Sep to 14 Oct 2026, v4.50 defaults: +$77.81, profit factor 1.33, maximum drawdown 5.37%, 127 trades, 83.5% won.
- 12 Jan to 14 Sep 2026, closest measured setup: +$99.33, profit factor 1.06, maximum drawdown 25.6%, 727 trades. Within that, 12 Jan to 14 May lost $181.94.
- Low drawdown preset (New York session only), same eight months: +$265.33, maximum drawdown 10.3%, 246 trades.
- Average win is smaller than average loss ($2.99 against $11.40 in the latest month), so a high win rate does not mean a large edge.
- Known weaknesses: losing stretches of several months, no public live account yet, gold only, MT5 only, needs MT5 running (a VPS in practice).

## Prop firms: can Gold Scalpers Pro be used?
Read on each firm's own rule pages on 13 November 2026. Firms change rules often.
- FTMO: purchased EAs are allowed. $400,000 maximum allocation per trader or strategy; funded standard accounts may not execute orders within 2 minutes of major news and may not hold over the weekend (Swing accounts are exempt).
- FundedNext: EAs only on MT4/MT5 accounts below $50,000, for an extra fee. $50,000 and above must be traded manually. EAs designed specifically to pass prop firm challenges, and EAs that use Telegram or WhatsApp, are prohibited.
- The5ers: not allowed. It prohibits an EA from a provider where the trader does not own the source code.
- FundingPips: not allowed for trading. A third-party EA is permitted only as a trade or risk manager.
- Prop-firm settings for a 5% daily / 10% maximum firm: PropFirmMode true, PropDailyLossPct 4, PropMaxDrawdownPct 8, Low drawdown preset, FixedLot 0.04 per $10,000.
- Gold Scalpers Pro is a gold trading EA with risk limits. It is not a challenge-passing tool and cannot guarantee a pass.

## Gold Scalpers AI (free app)
- A free web app for Android and iPhone at https://app.goldscalpers.com/ (installs from the browser; it is not in the Play Store or App Store).
- Shows BUY, SELL or WAIT for Gold, USDJPY and GBPJPY with an entry, a stop and three targets, plus AI chart analysis, news, a calendar and alerts. It gives signals only and does not place trades.
